name: Lyrio Farn
description: Long-range damage dealer.
Has good mobility.
spec: Agnitus, the Bow of Divine Fury - Arrow of Judgment
overview: A long-range archer who stores lightning charges on basic attacks and spends them on Q for bonus damage. R loads explosive shots that stun and add fire damage to the next skill. T hits harder the farther away the target is.
strengths: Huge single-target burst from range
Hard to pin down: W disengages, and E pushes enemies back and cuts damage from outside its radius by up to 80%
Strong self-heal (D)
weaknesses: Often out of range of team buffs

name: Stella Livve
description: Supporter. Focused on debuffs and utility skills.
overview: A support who weakens enemies and empowers the party. Q makes enemies take more damage, R makes them take more magic damage, and the scythe (A) cuts their healing and slows them. W raises skill damage for the hero and nearby allies.
strengths: Stacks several damage-taken debuffs on enemies
T keeps nearby allies from dropping below 1 HP, then heals them when it ends
E can drain enemies or heal allies
weaknesses: Can't really heal very well
Cannot replace a main support

name: Elric
role: Versatile Invoker. Has DPS, DoT, Support, Buffs, Debuffs
description: Ranged damage dealer. Focused on casting skills.
Requires more control compared to other characters, and skill combos are long.
spec: Benziena, the Rod of Earth - Enhanced Conjure Golem
Benziena, the Earthen Pillar - Enhanced Conjure Golem
Benziena, the Earthen Soul - Enhanced Conjure Golem
Benziena, the Earthen Heart - Enhanced Conjure Golem
Harmonia, the Sparkle of Life - Enhanced Conjure Golem
overview: A versatile caster who draws an element circle (Q fire, W water, E wind, R earth), then follows up with a second key for one of 16 transmutations. These cover damage, healing, shields, debuffs and a summoned golem. T resets every transmutation and amplifies skill damage by 12%.
strengths: Can do almost anything: damage, heals, cleanses, slows and debuffs
The earth golem taunts enemies and makes them take more magic damage
F trades HP for a large INT boost, 25% damage reduction and a big finishing blast
weaknesses: Long combos that take more control than most heroes

name: Haran Tenebras
description: Ranged damage dealer. Good at burst damage.
overview: Damage scales with max MP. W opens up to two portals that keep attacking, and Q hits hardest at its center. T transforms into a demon with new skills and full MP, and F can be cast while transformed for a big burst window.
strengths: High burst during the transformation
E absorbs incoming damage for the hero and allies, then reflects it back many times over
R gives +10% damage and +25% max HP
weaknesses: Revolves around the T transformation window

name: Loriro Livve
description: Melee damage dealer. Uses a good mix of auto attacks and skill casts.
Uses HP as resource to cast skills. Has excellent mobility.
spec: Teperua, the Ring of Blood - Blood Shield
overview: Damage scales with max HP, and INT adds more max HP. Empowered attacks charge up over time, and a blood gauge fuels Q, which hits harder with each cast in a row. R maxes attack speed and frees up W for repeated dashes.
strengths: Strong self-sustain: E pulls the target and heals up to 40% HP, and extra healing turns into a shield
Excellent mobility (W, with up to 3 casts during R)
Invulnerable while casting F
weaknesses: Needs a steady mix of basic attacks and skills to keep blood and charges flowing

name: Rin T.
description: Ranged damage dealer. Has high burst damage.
overview: Every hit sets enemies on fire, and Q and R make burning targets take extra damage. E grows stronger as it expands outward, and T calls down a meteor shower. Casting a skill gives a short burst of movement speed.
strengths: High burst damage
W can protect an ally by removing debuffs and adding a shield, or stun enemies on the ground
No MP to manage

name: Rainbow R.
description: Ranged damage dealer.
If setup around INT-based items/stats, can also be utilized as a healer that excels in small parties.
overview: Fights alongside drones (D) that join the attacks and can attach to allies. All skill damage uses Magitek affinity, which equals 70% of the highest elemental affinity.

statNotes.AGI: Ranged damage dealer with some healing on the side.
statNotes.INT: Healer that bounces heals between allies, breaks shields with E, and makes T's missiles pierce enemies and heal allies.

strengths: W shields an ally, removes debuffs and gives a speed boost
R makes the target take more damage, and E adds 4% more magic damage taken
INT excels in small parties
weaknesses: Hard to heal 3 or more players at once
Immobile

name: Shiro
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on auto-attacks.
Playstyle is simple compared to most other characters.
overview: A burst damage dealer who summons enchanted swords through attacks and skills, then spends them for bonus damage and quick dashes onto enemies. W, E and R are chants for speed, power or protection, and T extends the next chant to nearby allies.
strengths: Simple to play
Can buff allies with attack damage, speed or a cleanse and 50% damage reduction (T)
F stuns and makes the target take 50% more damage from enchanted swords

name: Lucicree
role: High Mobility with mid-ranged DoT DPS
description: Ranged damage dealer. Uses a good mix of auto attacks and skill casts.
overview: A revolver gunslinger with 6 bullets, mixing basic attacks with skills. Q tumbles and guarantees a crit on the next shot, R empties the cylinder, and T removes bullet costs and cuts cooldowns for a burst window.
strengths: Highly mobile at mid range (Q)
Shots never miss and ignore all armor
F deals extra damage to low-HP targets
weaknesses: Revolves around 30s and 15s burst windows

name: Louis Arcienne
role: High sustained damage (DoT dps), and strong stunner
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on casting skills, but it weaves auto-attacks in between skill casts.
overview: Weaves basic attacks between skills: each cast empowers the next attack for heavy damage that hits everything nearby. Q, W and E each chain into a follow-up. Finishing combos leaves illusion swords that boost AGI and can all be fired at once with R.
strengths: High sustained damage
T makes the target take 6% more damage
Stuns and knockbacks give strong crowd control
weaknesses: Damage depends on weaving basic attacks between skills

name: Dorothy de Merrian
description: Ranged damage dealer & support. Focused on summons.
spec: Benziena, the Earthen Pillar - Earth Mastery
Benziena, the Earthen Soul - Earth Mastery
Benziena, the Earthen Heart - Earth Mastery
Harmonia, the Sparkle of Life - Earth Mastery
overview: Summons elementals that fight alongside the hero: Q fire for damage, W water for healing, E lightning for ranged damage, R earth for protection. Each elemental's own skills come from pressing its key again. T recalls them to safety and heals them, and F summons a chaos elemental.
strengths: Covers many roles: water heals and cleanses, earth shields allies and cuts their damage taken, and lightning makes enemies take more magic damage
W boosts allies' Main Stat and restores their resources
D jumps for burst mobility
weaknesses: Summons need managing, which takes attention away from the hero

name: Sasuke
description: Melee damaged dealer. Requires precision with casting skills.
spec: Spiritus, the Sword of Elements - Spirits
overview: A close-range mage who shocks enemies with consecutive attacks. Skills that hit shocked targets can crit, and they chain into each other: W can be cast three times in a row. Q and R leave lightning orbs, which W's third cast detonates and E absorbs.
strengths: High burst once orbs are stacked
E dashes through enemies with 70% damage reduction and CC immunity, healing from orbs it absorbs
T makes the hero invulnerable, then refills energy and refreshes basic skills
weaknesses: Ping dependent

name: Astarte
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on casting skills.
Has good survivability and offensive support for allies.
spec: Bahanar, the Sword of Illusion - Sword of Illusion
Bahanar, the True Sword of Illusion - Sword of Illusion
Meacronacer, the Sword of Thousand Illusions - Sword of Thousand Illusions
Astra, the Sword of Moonlight - Flash of Moonlight
overview: A tanky frontliner who's easy to pick up. She dashes and leaps into fights, raises nearby allies' Main Stat, and makes her target take more damage.
strengths: Very durable: damage reduction, self-healing, and extra protection at low HP
Gives the party +4% Main Stat and makes enemies take 6% more damage
Two gap-closers (R and E)

name: Kenneth Deracoon
role: Close-range burst DPS, decent DoT dps
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused HEAVILY on auto attacks, and has almost no skill casts.
Playstyle is simple compared to most other characters.
spec: Grandine, the Plates of Wraith - Wraith Possession
Athanasia, the Armor of the Reaper - Reaper Possession
Exitium, the Armor of Ruin - Bringer of Ruin
overview: Fights almost entirely with fast basic attacks that randomly trigger extra strikes and debuffs. D dodges the next hit and counters, and F gives a burst window with +70% skill damage, +250% attack speed and CC immunity.
strengths: Simple playstyle with very few skill casts
Lowers enemy armor by 40% and makes them take more proc damage (E)
Self-sustaining: R randomly adds attack damage, damage reduction and regen
weaknesses: Damage depends on random procs

name: Naomi Mercedes
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
Provides a bit of offensive support.
overview: A spear fighter whose skills can crit. She powers up each skill with D, breaks barriers, and finishes off low-HP targets.
strengths: Breaks barriers, and E deals extra damage to low-HP targets
Makes her target take 4% more damage and gives allies she hits +6% Main Stat (T)
Self-sustaining: ki regen also heals her, and R pulls her back out of danger
weaknesses: Gets +15% damage only while her ki is above 50%
Needs D cast before skills to get their empowered effects

name: Aurelia
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
Skill combos are more complex compared to other characters.
overview: A scythe fighter built around skill combos. D refreshes Q and E, W stacks extra damage for repeating the same kind of hit, and E powers up Q for a big burst. F marks a target to take more damage the lower its HP, then hits hard when the mark ends.
strengths: High burst damage
Hard to take down: R cuts damage taken by 80% with CC immunity, and T gives another 30%
Strong mobility (D and E)
weaknesses: Revolves around 15s and 30s burst windows

name: Ayame
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on casting skills.
Has stealth abilities.
overview: All skills can crit. Q and W reset each other and build marks that raise crit chance, and full marks let T fire instantly with shadows that copy the next skill. Slips into stealth when out of combat, and E turns invisible for a big opening hit.
strengths: High burst damage
Safe while hidden: 30% damage reduction in stealth, and R keeps stealth up inside the smoke
weaknesses: Short burst windows: damage drops off between T casts

name: Aisha
description: Supporter. Has various healing and supportive abilities.
spec: Diana, the Robe of Holy Maiden - Maiden's Blessing
Crown of Serenity - Protector of Wind
Crown of Cleansing - Protector of Wind
overview: An AoE healer whose heals give allies +Main Stat and 8% damage reduction. Q toggles spirits between healing and attacking. R lays a healing field that raises allies' HP and skill damage, and F summons a guardian that heals, revives and fights.
strengths: Strong party-wide healing
2 party revives
E absorbs 45% of the damage nearby allies take, then blasts enemies with it
T heals the party and grants debuff immunity
D moves quickly with 40% damage reduction and can recall back

name: Catherine Yoi
description: Supporter. Excels in adventurous parties where deaths are frequent.
spec: Bag of Mighty Strength - Heavy Bag
Bag of Mighty Strength +1 - Heavy Bag
Bag of Hell - Very Heavy Bag
Bag of Corruption - Very Heavy Bag
Bag of Destruction - Very Heavy Bag
Bag of Demise - Very Heavy Bag
Bag of All Evils - Very Heavy Bag
Bag of Heaven - Very Light Bag
Bag of Life - Very Light Bag
Bag of Mother Nature - Very Light Bag
Bag of Universe - Very Light Bag
overview: A support who keeps the party alive. She revives fallen allies, shields the party with her own HP, and makes enemies take more damage. Her bag sets her style: healing potions or bombs.
strengths: Revives an ally at full HP/MP, or saves herself if she dies while T is ready
Shields the party (E) and gives one ally +30% damage and −60% damage taken (F)
Best in risky content where deaths are frequent
weaknesses: Low APM (actions per minute)

name: Esteria
role: Shield Breaker/DoT DPS with small Burst DPS
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on auto-attacks.
spec: Guardian of the Skies - Improved Magnetic Field
Ruler of the Skies - Improved Magnetic Field
overview: A spear fighter whose basic attacks ignore 80% of armor, with every 4th attack striking twice. Dealing or taking damage builds a magnetic field that adds attack damage, attack speed and damage reduction. R spends it for a shield-breaking burst.
strengths: Simple, auto-attack-focused playstyle
Breaks shields (R)
Durable: the magnetic field adds up to 20% damage reduction, and E adds 30% more
weaknesses: Low APM (actions per minute)

name: Elena
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on auto attacks.
Instead of MP, she uses HP to cast skills.
overview: Pays for skills with HP and gets stronger as her HP drops. She heals on every hit and can refuse to die for a short time (T).
strengths: Simple, auto-attack-focused playstyle
At low HP: +15% damage, up to 50% damage reduction, and more attack damage
Heals 6% max HP on every basic attack
weaknesses: While her E toggle is on, she gets 85% less healing and can't go above 30% HP, so healers barely help her

name: Iris Millen
description: Ranged damage dealer.
Provides some support for allies.
overview: An elven archer whose arrows explode every few seconds and store charges, letting Q and W skip their cooldowns. A guardian scout (E) follows along, joining attacks and buffing nearby allies. T and F rain down big volleys.
strengths: Gives nearby allies +4% attack damage and Main Stat, and E's active boosts their HP regen
Strong crowd control: Q stuns, W slows, and T stuns everything it hits

name: Isabelle che Nyderre
description: Melee all-rounder class. Quite tanky.Has supportive abilities such as moving/breaking monsters or providing shields to allies.
spec: Guardian Ring - Improved Seal of Mana
True Guardian Ring - Improved Seal of Mana
Ispion, the Runed Ring - Improved Seal of Mana
Heirloom of Lazarus - Improved Seal of Mana
overview: A mana-powered tank. Her max MP grows with STR + INT, and her skills spend it for damage. She protects the party, breaks barriers, and pushes monsters around.
strengths: Very tanky: E halves incoming damage, and she regenerates 10% MP per second
Shares her damage reduction with allies and amplifies everyone's skill damage by 4% (T)
Big party save: F gives allies it hits 100% damage reduction and debuff immunity for 5 seconds
Breaks barriers and shields allies as she charges (W)

name: Karad Erin
role: INT: Support Utility and AoE Healer
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
spec: Seal of Deceiver - Power of Inversion
overview: Fights with souls gathered over time and from skills. The main stat decides the role.

statNotes.STR: Burst damage with self-healing. Damage grows with consecutive E casts and the souls spent.
statNotes.INT: Support. Heals and shields allies, makes enemies take more magic damage, and protects the party with 60% damage reduction and death prevention.

strengths: Two distinct roles in one hero
weaknesses: Running low on souls limits how often skills can be used

name: Eustia
description: Ranged damage dealer. Has high burst damage but skill combo is complex.
overview: Damage scales with max MP. Two Q stars colliding explode for 500% damage, and W amplifies skill damage against its target. D restores HP and MP and refreshes cooldowns, and F summons stars that fire alongside each Q.
strengths: High burst damage
R dashes away twice, turning invisible with 40% damage reduction
Some support: Q heals allies, and F can switch to protecting an ally with heals
weaknesses: Complex combos, especially lining up star collisions

name: Sherry P.
description: Ranged damage dealer & support. Good with CC effects.
spec: Frost Herald's Garment - Improved Frozen Emotion
overview: Landing two skills in a row makes the target vulnerable, and the next skill deals 200% bonus damage. Q's cooldown resets whenever another skill is cast. D buffs up to 2 allies with bonus attack damage, skill damage and a recharging barrier.
strengths: Strong crowd control: Q, R and T freeze, and F pauses enemies
Buffs and shields allies (D), and E refills their barriers
High burst once vulnerability is set up
weaknesses: Damage depends on alternating skills to keep applying vulnerability

name: Alice Dorneea
description: Supporter. Focused on healing skills. Excels in large parties.
spec: Ring of Deep Darkness - Transmission of Darkness
Grimoire of Darkness - Transmission of Darkness
Seed of Malice - Transmission of Darkness
overview: A dedicated healer who excels in large parties. The aura gives nearby allies +8% attack damage, and E's follow-up raises their skill damage. T summons an angel who can fully heal and cleanse an ally, pull an ally to safety, or revive a fallen one.
strengths: Top-tier party healing and protection
F gives the party +6% final damage and 15% less damage taken
R shields allies and grants debuff immunity
weaknesses: Constant micro of Raguel, the angel summon

name: Frederic Kassia
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on casting skills.
Has good mobility and support for allies.
spec: Visvire, the Hammer of Storm - Improved Genesis
overview: Every 7th attack triggers Judgment. The chosen aura (D) decides whether Judgment and Sigils add skill damage, shields, heals or cleanses. W dashes in and hands Sigils to allies.

statNotes.STR: +10% damage, and Sigils also amplify skill damage.
statNotes.INT: Devotion: deals 40% less damage, but gets a bigger aura, heals allies, and extends T and F protection to the party.

strengths: Flexible support: the aura can be swapped to fit the party
Strong mobility (W)
weaknesses: High APM (actions per minute)

name: Harang
description: Ranged damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
Requires constant input of keys; not recommended if you have a bad wrist.
overview: A melee fighter with slightly longer reach than most. Slashes up to 3 times in a row, ignoring armor, and spends souls for bonus damage. R dodges the next attack, refills souls and resets W and E. T removes soul costs for 6 seconds and amplifies skill damage by 12%.
strengths: High damage that keeps up through the fight
R lets a well-timed dodge restore souls and resets skills
weaknesses: High APM (actions per minute): needs constant key input, so it isn't recommended if you have wrist strain

name: The Nameless One
description: Supporter. Focused on healing skills.
overview: Every 4th attack heals the hero and two nearby allies. The highest stat decides the role.

statNotes.AGI: Damage dealer. Skills deal 100% more damage, and R costs no Ki.
statNotes.STR/INT: Healer. Activates Harmony, which boosts healing, lets Q target allies and makes enemies take more damage. Heals also give allies +2.5% final damage.

strengths: Easy to play
Easily overheals multiple people
weaknesses: Low APM (actions per minute)

name: Yue Tenebras
description: Supporter. Focused on utility skills.
overview: A utility support. E brews potions that heal and raise Main Stat, and pairing it with Q makes enemies take more magic damage. T summons a fallen angel who breaks barriers and marks up to 3 allies for +5% damage, damage reduction and attack speed.
strengths: R freezes enemies and makes allies immune to harmful effects for 2 seconds
F makes enemies take 10% more magic damage
Breaks barriers (T → Q)
weaknesses: The summon needs managing alongside the hero's own skills

name: Noface
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts, and relies heavily on combos.
Requires constant input of keys; not recommended if you have a bad wrist.
overview: Builds combo stacks by chaining actions: repeating one (AAA) or alternating them (AWA). Changing combo types stacks up to 4 times for more attack and skill damage. Cracking and shattering enemies sets up big hits.
strengths: High damage ceiling and skill expression
Makes the target take 6% more damage (E)
F latches onto a boss and shatters it
weaknesses: High APM (actions per minute), and a failed combo resets the stacks

name: Luk
description: Melee damage dealer. Difficult as it requires controlling two characters at once.
overview: Fights alongside an illusion that copies every move. Q marks the target, and E and T consume the marks for big hits. R throws cards that can be teleported to, and F resets T for a second finisher.
strengths: High burst once marks are stacked
Highly mobile: E swaps places with the illusion, and R teleports to cards
The illusion takes 40% reduced damage, and R's teleport adds a short damage reduction
weaknesses: Hard to play: you control two characters at once

name: Mina
description: Ranged damage dealer. Has some supportive abilities.
overview: Fights alongside a fox spirit. R creates water and fire talismans: water ones power up the next skill automatically, and fire ones let it be recast as a fire version. T merges with the fox for 8 seconds, turning every skill into fire and amplifying skill damage by 12%.
strengths: R also places a dome that heals allies and gives them +6% water affinity and 12% less damage taken
Some healing from skills that use water talismans and from F's explosions
Uses both fire and water affinity
weaknesses: Talisman management adds an extra layer to every rotation

name: Maru
description: Damage dealer. Relies on numerous skill casts.
overview: Spawns and collects orbs of light, turning them into stacks that power up R's charged kick. T resets basic skill cooldowns, and a fully charged T adds +25% skill damage and extra resets.
strengths: Frequent cooldown resets create big burst windows
Infinite mobility
Lots of burst range
weaknesses: Extremely high APM and repetition

name: Yuzuka
description: Ranged damage dealer. Relies greatly on attacks.
overview: A heavily armed gunner whose basic attacks burn, ignore all armor and splash. E sets up crits for the skills, and missiles load on their own and fire all at once with T.
strengths: High range
Simple to play, with a shield that builds up every second
Armor-ignoring splash attacks
weaknesses: Immobile
Gets no attack speed from AGI and only half from other sources

name: Celeste
description: Melee damage dealer. Unleashes fast combos using her sword and arcane magic.
overview: Mixes swordplay with arcane magic, with most skills scaling on STR + INT. W and R mark the target, and Q and T consume the mark for crits, resets and shield breaking.
strengths: E completely blocks the next skill hit and counters
T breaks shields on a marked target
R also heals allies
weaknesses: Damage depends on applying and consuming marks in the right order
